units.name: collectively_bargained_plan_ind
units.description: Mark if the plan is a collectively-bargained plan

units.name: retroactively_adopted_plan_ind
units.description: Mark if this is a retroactively adopted plan permitted by SECURE Act section 201

units.name: administrator_same_as_sponsor_ind
units.description: Mark if plan administrator’s name and address are the Same as Plan Sponsor.

units.name: all_assets_invested_eligible_ind
units.description: Were all of the plan’s assets during the plan year invested in eligible assets? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: iqpa_waiver_claimed_ind
units.description: Are you claiming a waiver of the annual examination and report of an independent qualified public accountant (IQPA) under 29 CFR 2520.104-46? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: pbgc_insurance_coverage_ind
units.description: If the plan is a defined benefit plan, is it covered under the PBGC insurance program (see ERISA section 4021)? Mark Yes, No or Not determined.

units.name: failure_to_transmit_contributions_ind
units.description: Was there a failure to transmit to the plan any participant contributions within the time period described in 29 CFR 2510.3-102? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: nonexempt_party_in_interest_transactions_ind
units.description: Were there any nonexempt transactions with any party-in-interest? (Do not include transactions reported on line 10a? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: fidelity_bond_coverage_ind
units.description: Was the plan covered by a fidelity bond? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: plan_loss_fidelity_bond_ind
units.description: Did the plan have a loss, whether or not reimbEnteursed by the plan’s fidelity bond, that was caused by fraud or dishonesty? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: fees_commissions_paid_ind
units.description: Were any fees or commissions paid to any brokers, agents, or other persons by an insurance carrier, insurance service, or other organization that provides some or all of the benefits under the plan? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: failure_to_provide_benefit_ind
units.description: Has the plan failed to provide any benefit when due under the plan? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: participant_loans_ind
units.description: Did the plan have any participant loans? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: blackout_period_ind
units.description: If this is an individual account plan, was there a blackout period? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: blackout_period_notice_exception_ind
units.description: If 10h was answered “Yes,” check the box if you either provided the required notice or one of the exceptions to providing the notice applied under 29 CFR 2520.101-3. Mark Yes or No.

units.name: is_defined_benefit_minimum_funding_ind
units.description: Is this a defined benefit plan subject to minimum funding requirements? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: pbgc_missed_contribution_notification_cd
units.description: If the plan is covered by PBGC and the amount reported on line 11a is greater than $0, has PBGC been notified as required by ERISA sections 4043(c)(5) and/or 303(k)(4)? Mark applicable box.

units.name: is_defined_contribution_minimum_funding_ind
units.description: Is this a defined contribution plan subject to the minimum funding requirements of section 412 of the Code or section 302 of ERISA? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: minimum_funding_deadline_met_ind
units.description: Will the minimum funding amount reported on line 12d be met by the funding deadline? Mark Yes, No or N/A.

units.name: termination_resolution_adopted_ind
units.description: Has a resolution to terminate the plan been adopted in any plan year? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: all_plan_assets_distributed_ind
units.description: Were all the plan assets distributed to participants or beneficiaries, transferred to another plan, or brought under the control of the PBGC? Mark Yes or No.

units.name: permissive_aggregation_coverage_test_ind
units.description: Does the plan satisfy the coverage and nondiscrimination tests of Code sections 410(b) and 401(a)(4) by combining this plan with any other plans under the permissive aggregation rules? Mark Yes or No.
